clues.it: Nino era nella 1ª riga, a ovest di Dario e da solo nel Canyon.
clues.en: Nino was in the 1st row, west of Dario and alone in the Canyon.

clues.it: Olga era nella stessa stanza di Anna.
clues.en: Olga was in the same room as Anna.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 3ª riga e accanto a una sputacchiera, ma non era accanto a un cavallo.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 3rd row and beside a spittoon, but was not beside a horse.

clues.it: Anna era nella 11ª colonna, nella 4ª riga e in una stanza diversa da Dario.
clues.en: Anna was in the 11th column, in the 4th row and in a different room from Dario.

clues.it: Vito era nella 10ª colonna e nella 5ª riga, ma non era accanto a un cartellone di taglia.
clues.en: Vito was in the 10th column and in the 5th row, but was not beside a wanted poster.

clues.it: Elena era nella 6ª riga e nell'Ufficio dello Sceriffo, ma non era accanto a un cactus.
clues.en: Elena was in the 6th row and in the Sheriff's Office, but was not beside a cactus.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Dario era nella 13ª colonna, nella 8ª riga e in una stanza diversa da Anna.
clues.en: Dario was in the 13th column, in the 8th row and in a different room from Anna.

clues.it: Sergio era l'unico seduto su una sedia, a ovest di Paolo e nell'Ufficio dello Sceriffo.
clues.en: Sergio was the only one sitting on a chair, west of Paolo and in the Sheriff's Office.

clues.it: Giada era a ovest di Rosa e alla Stazione.
clues.en: Giada was west of Rosa and at the Depot.

clues.it: Luca era nella 8ª colonna ed esattamente una riga a nord di Paolo.
clues.en: Luca was in the 8th column and exactly one row north of Paolo.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 12ª colonna e accanto a un cactus.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 12th column and beside a cactus.

clues.it: Carla era nella 13ª riga, accanto a una cassaforte e a ovest di Fabio.
clues.en: Carla was in the 13th row, beside a safe and west of Fabio.

clues.it: Rosa era accanto a un abbeveratoio, ma non era accanto a un bancone.
clues.en: Rosa was beside a water trough, but was not beside a bar counter.

clues.it: Marta era accanto a un cartellone di taglia e in una stanza diversa da Olga.
clues.en: Marta was beside a wanted poster and in a different room from Olga.
